description: Starting scenarios (concept §9). Two of them, crossed with three doctrines, give the six campaign openings §6.1 asks for before the first fork. A scenario is a situation, not a difficulty: one starts you with nothing and no obligations, the other with hardware you did not choose and a debt you did not want.

scenarios.title: Series Zero
scenarios.summary: A hangar, a licence, and whatever the doctrine pays for.
scenarios.opening: Nobody has heard of you. Nobody is owed anything either.

scenarios.title: Inherited Hardware
scenarios.summary: You bought a failed competitor's stock, and their creditors.
scenarios.opening: The parts are flight-proven because someone else flew them. The debt is yours from Monday.

sandbox.title: Sandbox
sandbox.summary: No fixed costs, no deadlines, everything you have researched.
